scope: Consumer messaging unless the feature specifies business. Apple RCS columns cover the named OS families on eligible carriers. The Universal Profile column covers capabilities specified in editions 3.0 through 4.1; it does not assert client deployment. Video attachments and live calls are distinct.

source_guide: Dates refer to publication or the documented release unless marked accessed. Vendor-claim includes first-party product docs and normative trade-body specifications; estimate includes unresolved availability and community-only evidence.
